records.text: Start the url-capture feature set: the URL-level loopback web-reputation pipeline, design-first then staged implementation

body.conditions: PROVENANCE: operator direction, hugh, 2026-08-31, relayed verbatim by checker: "ok to request builder start the url-capture feature set". This lifts the discussion-only status of notes/2026-08-30-web-domain-reputation.md (live artifact 36decf15 at merge a7c52eda, latest note revision 651dc83, approved by checker 7b460a80) into tasked work. SCOPE is the loopback design as merged: one Tailapp with three OTLP-flavored input families (URL observations carrying the fetched URL as a DEDICATED attribute, never the guard-shared target attribute; exclusion records materializing an exclusions table on top of no-configuration defaults for loopback/private-range literals, localhost, single-label, .local/.internal/.home.arpa/.test; url-reputation verdict records emitted back by the assessing agent), so that unchecked = observed minus excluded minus fresh-verdict is an ordinary query with no side-cache; plus daily-review cron instructions and an EXAMPLE companion script that reads the unchecked list, applies the exclusions a second time before egress, queries Google Safe Browsing or VirusTotal, and emits url-reputation OTLP records to the resident. The scan layer stays instructions-plus-script: no engine code and no fold logic for scanning. STAGE 1 (deliver first, for checker review before any implementation): a design-decision note under notes/ that resolves the six open questions of the merged note with a concrete recommended answer and rationale each. OQ1 capture route and the reputation-service choice/licensing (Safe Browsing non-commercial vs Web Risk; VirusTotal public-API terms) are OPERATOR decisions: present each as explicit options with a recommended default and mark them for operator ratification rather than deciding silently. OQ2 must state the private-event and table shapes and name the single writing program per table under the two-stage topology and single-writer rules. OQ3 verdict freshness, OQ4 companion-script home/schema/key handling, OQ5 retention and reset semantics, OQ6 whether the script strips path-and-query secrets before transmission (recommendation: yes by default, with the precision cost stated). The stage-1 note must also include the staged implementation plan (suggested: stage 2 Tailapp source set with fixtures and embed tests; stage 3 companion script plus cron instructions with a scrubbed fixture end-to-end; stage 4 docs/catalog integration including README catalog row and privacy statement) with each stage independently reviewable at an exact head. CONSTRAINTS carried forward unchanged: existing RuntimeID/revision digests unaffected until a stage explicitly says otherwise; no new confinement holes; privacy posture change (full URL retention locally, transmission only of selected non-excluded URLs) stated plainly in user-facing docs; existing bundles untouched except explicit catalog listing. Address the stage-1 review request to checker at an exact committed head; go test ./..., go vet ./..., go test -race ./... must pass at every reviewed head.

records.text: OPERATOR RATIFICATION, hugh, 2026-08-31, relayed verbatim by checker, for the URL reputation stage-1 ratification gate in notes/2026-08-31-url-reputation-stage-1-decisions.md (head 0980309a, artifact 994c63b4): "capture: dedicated adapter; provider: noncommercial (these are primarily user-instructions and helper scripts, not core dependencies, so usage will vary); egress agree." DECISIONS: (1) CAPTURE = the narrow dedicated adapter emitting tailapp.url.observed with tailapp.url.observed_full / tailapp.url.host; the broad harness detail gate stays documented only as a bootstrap alternative. This confirms checker R1 in verdict beb4368a: the corrected note must add the reference adapter as a real deliverable (mechanism, home, stage, tests). (2) PROVIDER = the non-commercial posture: Google Safe Browsing v5 is the documented default for this project, whose scan layer is user instructions plus helper scripts rather than a core dependency, so eligibility is determined per installation by the person running it. The companion should therefore support the provider set with Safe Browsing v5 as its documented default, present Web Risk Lookup as the option when commercial use cannot be ruled out, keep VirusTotal Premium-only, and state plainly in its README and the daily-review instructions that the installing user is responsible for confirming their own eligibility under the cited terms; no provider is a core dependency and none is contacted without an explicit provider choice and credential. (3) EGRESS = agreed as proposed: mandatory user-info/fragment/query removal plus high-confidence path-secret redaction before any lookup, path-preserving mode as the only alternative, no query-sending mode. Builder: fold these into the corrected stage-1 note alongside R1 and the advisories, then re-request review at the exact head; stage 2 may begin once that note is approved.

url-capture Stage 2, corrected re-issue (replaces db73307c): build the url-reputation built-in Tailapp per the stage-1 note, checker decision efac0734 (single-fold topology), and the ratified due-query amendment (due list = observations lacking a fresh provider verdict; exclusions exported separately; the companion is the mandatory pre-egress exclusion filter). No runtime change of any kind.

body.conditions: (1) implementation per checker decisions efac0734 AND the due-query amendment ratified on 58e6392e: normalizer emits url_pipeline_event (lowercase authority-prefix+boundary host check; day_utc = $floor($number(t)/86400000000000)); ONE fold is sole writer of all four tables; no RuntimeID, canonicalization, evaluator, or query-authorizer change; (2) the shipped due query selects observations lacking a fresh provider verdict using only allowlisted aggregate functions and makes no exclusion claim; enabled exclusions are exported as a queryable table; docs state that exclusion enforcement (exact/suffix/prefix/built-in) is performed by the Stage 3 companion immediately before egress; (3) capture stays within the ratified adapter/provider/egress policy (assert c9c7fa4c) with no new egress; (4) notes/2026-08-31-url-reputation-stage-1-decisions.md section 2 amended to record the topology and the due-query/exclusion split; (5) delivered on a branch off current main 4eb7429 with an exact-head review request to checker, per-file full-sha artifacts with raw-file sha256 digests, and the full battery green
